selected_interpretation_after_clarificat: Run V5-G3 on the Mac Studio host; reserve the office setting for a later presenter gate.

execution_host.implementation_constraint: Use PIL, NumPy, Matplotlib, and FFmpeg; do not require OpenCV. Use explicit Homebrew FFmpeg paths because the non-interactive SSH PATH does not expose them.

v5_g3.scope: Local no-face motion-graphics canary on Mac Studio

later_presenter_gate.office_setting: Warm modern research office with neutral daylight, restrained astronomy graphics, clean shelves or whiteboard, no corporate logos, no sci-fi laboratory styling, and no visual clutter.
later_presenter_gate.presenter_limits: At most 15 seconds in the introduction and 10 seconds in the ending.
later_presenter_gate.gesture_rule: No reusable short hand-motion loop; either distinct bounded gestures or hands out of frame.
later_presenter_gate.science_scene_rule: Science remains full-screen plots and graphics; the office presenter does not remain on screen during evidence explanation.
